newsitem.title: CHINA: China copper consumption up 12 pct in first qtr.
newsitem.headline: China copper consumption up 12 pct in first qtr.

text.p: China's total consumption of copper rose 12 percent in the first three months of 1997 to 260,000 tonnes from the same period last year, the China Securities newspaper said on Sunday.
Copper consumption picked up after the Lunar New Year holiday in February with an increase in the flow of working capital, it said.
Working capital availability tightens in the lead-up to the new year holiday as factories need cash to pay workers their new year bonus.
The newspaper said the domestic copper market faced an oversupply of copper with high stocks left over from last year. It did not give further details.
However, the official press has reported a national stockpile at the end of 1996 of 170,000 tonnes.
If copper exports continued to rise while imports fall over the next few months, the oversupply situation was likely to be reversed, the newspaper said.
